rules: Check binding status first. If a journal, funder or regulator requires a standard, that choice is already made.
Pick one standard to describe the model, one to document testing, and one way to share the code and data. That covers most needs.
Prefer the newest version of a family (ODD 2020 over ODD 2006) unless your venue asks for another.
Extensions (ODD+D, ODD+2D) add to a base standard; they do not replace it.
Most entries are not yet independently verified. Read the banner on a card before you cite it.
